protocol.analysis_unit: independent training seed; repeats averaged within environment and lineage
protocol.primary_outcomes: intact-minus-mirrored mean meals in each environment; positive steering gain; steering gain above founders
protocol.primary_family: four two-sided exact paired sign tests with Holm correction
protocol.decision: all four tests must have Holm p < 0.05 and a positive mean-difference interval
protocol.limitations: operational food-guidance evidence, not human-like cognition; hidden inputs can cause distribution shift; secondary contrasts descriptive

analysis.interpretation: Generalized food seeking was not demonstrated by all four operational criteria; this does not establish absence of every food-dependent strategy.
